moments.quote: Fate has ordained that the men who went to the moon to explore in peace will stay on the moon to rest in peace.
moments.short: …the men who went to the moon to explore in peace will stay on the moon to rest in peace.

moments.alt: In the recorded Cabinet Room meeting, President Kennedy tells NASA Administrator James Webb that the cost of the Moon program is justified only by beating the Soviet Union, and that he is not that interested in space.

moments.quote: There is a requirement for a manned military outpost on the moon.
moments.short: There is a requirement for a manned military outpost on the moon.

moments.quote: Empty cargo and propellant containers have been assembled and are being used for storage of bulk supplies, weapons, and life essentials such as insulated oxygen/nitrogen tanks.
moments.short: Empty cargo and propellant containers … are being used for storage of bulk supplies, weapons…

moments.quote: To this day there has been no indication the Soviets ever discovered that the Lunik was borrowed for a night.
moments.short: …there has been no indication the Soviets ever discovered that the Lunik was borrowed for a night.

moments.alt: Overhead KH-8 satellite view of a launch pad at Tyuratam: an arrow labeled SPACE BOOSTER points to the Soviet N1 Moon rocket standing at the center of the pad.

moments.quote: Unbeknown to the public, the MOL program included a highly secret set of experiments and capabilities to gain intelligence from space.
moments.short: Unbeknown to the public, the MOL program included a highly secret set of experiments…
